test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How does public transport contribute to equity?

options.text: By focusing only on commercial zones
By connecting low-income communities with wealthy areas,
By offering free rides on weekends

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights that equity in public transport means **serving low-income communities along with commercial hubs**. (न्याय / समानता)
 
• This ensures that people from all social and economic backgrounds benefit equally.
 
• Therefore, connecting low-income communities with wealthy areas makes transport equitable.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3) By connecting low-income communities with wealthy areas**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: By keeping fares high (किराया बढ़ाकर रखना)** – This would make transport less accessible, especially for low-income groups.

 **Example:** High metro fares discourage daily wage workers from using it.
 
• **Option 2: By focusing only on commercial zones (केवल वाणिज्यिक क्षेत्रों पर ध्यान देना)** – This ignores the needs of poor and residential areas.

 **Example:** A network that connects only business districts excludes many citizens.
 
• **Option 4: By offering free rides on weekends (सप्ताहांत पर मुफ्त यात्रा देना)** – This may help temporarily but does not address equity in daily commuting.

 **Example:** Free weekend rides won’t solve weekday travel struggles for workers.

13c:Td54,

The correct answer is **Option 2**.
